numerator: Eligible enrolled nodes with a timely valid report at the declared instant.
denominator: All eligible enrolled nodes in the authorized scope, including unreachable nodes.
deduplication: Exact cluster, node and membership epoch in the independently resolved scope.

numerator: Intended protected nodes with current evidence of the required enforcement state.
denominator: All nodes intended to be protected in the authorized scope, including unknown and stale states.
deduplication: Exact cluster, node and membership epoch in the independently resolved scope.

numerator: Eligible managed nodes with current attestation of conformity to the exact policy.
denominator: All eligible managed nodes in the authorized scope, including unknown and stale states.
deduplication: Exact cluster, node and membership epoch in the independently resolved scope.

numerator: Expected eligible source observations meeting the exact freshness policy.
denominator: All expected eligible source observations in the half-open interval, including missing observations.
deduplication: Exact cluster, node, membership epoch, source and expected slot; receipt retries are not new slots.

numerator: Unique eligible transactions with a verified successful result by their verification deadline.
denominator: All eligible transactions whose verification deadline falls in the half-open interval.
deduplication: Exact cluster, node, membership epoch and transaction ID; retries are not new transactions.

numerator: Eligible retained observations with the selected authoritative severity category.
denominator: All eligible retained observations in the same authorized snapshot and half-open interval.
deduplication: Exact cluster, node, membership epoch and event ID; overlapping groups are not new observations.
